repository.description: 完整Registry/repository，无scheme、tag或digest；所属publisher namespace按路径段严格比较，不使用字符串模糊前缀。

ArtifactReference.description: 可定位不可变OCI image身份；读取manifest必须精确匹配三个字段，不用latest或静默跨平台。

repository.description: 完整Registry/repository，无scheme、tag或digest；所属publisher namespace按路径段严格比较，不使用字符串模糊前缀。

RecipeArtifact.description: 由发布者准入的不可变BuildKit recipe归档，不是客户任意Dockerfile；校验归档路径/recipe摘要。

BuildRecipeContract.description: BuildKit三个命名context严格runtime/agent_package/webui；发布者recipe只能消费这些输入，网络none。需要联网依赖须由发布者预置在已批准digest中。输出平台必须等于Runtime与WebUI平台；准入执行官方/第三方契约测试，不推测COPY路径。

ModelConfigurationContract.description: PUT applyPath提交ModelConfigurationPayload{version:int64 string,selections:[{slot,modelId}]}，GET readbackPath返回ModelConfigurationReadback；重复同version同payload返回同结果，异payload冲突；不能借此写应用任意JSON。 portName引用applicationRevisionTemplate.ports；authorizationSecretInputName引用其SecretInputs，不另发明SecretSlot或用Gateway Key代替控制凭据。

DataContract.description: 数据schema由发布者拥有；存在read_write且不支持并发的mount时更新必须停止旧writer再挂新实例，不能双写。迁移/备份是明确artifact与格式，不启发式转换。

WebuiPublisherContract.description: 本期WebUI合入单一OCI；不支持独立服务WebUI，必须显式拒绝而非自建服务。staticRoot由Runtime buildRecipe.webuiInput.sourcePath逐字段相等；entryFile必须存在，路由/静态/SSE测试通过。

PublisherContractReference.description: Capability typed解析后编码一次并把确切UTF-8 bytes写入不可变Storage对象，计算SHA256；digest/objectRef都由Owner返回，客户端不报。JSONB仅结构投影，Resolver校验存储原字节，禁止重新序列化JSONB猜摘要。

DeploymentDescriptor.description: Build产物不可变快照：applicationRevision从Runtime template逐字段复制，只按Build批准转换替换image/version/applicationId及recipe声明的输入绑定；其余变动一律重新发布契约。运行只消费applicationRevision，不重复解释template执行字段。legacy直接保留既有canonical revision，不改路径/Key/入口。 legacy_application分支只保留artifact+applicationRevision+旧revision ID；禁止伪造Runtime/WebUI发布描述、Package或recipe。

WorkspaceApplicationDependencyCommand.description: 源Go contract允许的明确environment string map，不是任意domain JSON；Secret值禁止进入env，必须SecretInputs。

WorkspaceApplicationRevision.description: 现有packages/contracts/go/workspace_application.go WorkspaceApplicationRevision的wire投影，不是平行应用格式。所有新输入必须同时通过当前Go ValidateWorkspaceApplicationRevision/StartupOrder/Inputs/Execution。image=repository@digest；platform来自ArtifactReference精确拼接。main使用entrypoint覆盖，main默认CMD来自批准镜像；依赖command.entrypoint/args/env保持原语义。

ApplicationOwnedAccessContract.description: 应用自有会话/登录协议，保持现有WorkspaceApplicationCredential密码与session-secret能力；Cloud不把平台cookie传应用。

CloudPrivateAccessContract.description: 复用当前canonical exposurePolicy与WorkspaceApplicationEntry；provider未具受保护入口能力时准入拒绝，不自行发App session、GatewayOIDC或改应用登录。Source当前cloud_private不发布公网入口，不能伪装可打开。

AnonymousAccessContract.description: 仅发布者明确声明且平台准入允许；不因访问故障降级为anonymous。

PackageFormatContractReference.description: 引用Framework/OMA当前发布者验证器与schema，不在Cloud定义另一种包格式。生产准入必须Owner release/readback与签名收据吻合；例子的formatVersion/仓库都是合成fixture，不表示已发布标准。

x-semantic-validation: Source Go validators are mandatory for applicationRevisionTemplate and emitted applicationRevision; this schema supplements, never substitutes the canonical domain validation.
Runtime image repo@digest/platform equals its applicationRevisionTemplate image/platform. Emitted Revision image equals final ArtifactReference.
Ports, config/secret references, mounts, startup dependency DAG and compute envelopes must validate through canonical owner types.

ModelConfiguration portName resolves declared main port and authorizationSecretInputName resolves SecretInputs. Access mode exactly equals exposurePolicy; never replace application auth with fake Gateway OIDC.
Third-party repository path must be inside approved PublisherNamespace exact path components; no official namespace reuse.
BuildKit recipe and explicit command/CMD use immutable approved inputs; no network or arbitrary customer Dockerfile.
Canonical execution image preserves dependencies and main data path/credentials when imported from legacy; no fabricated Build or changed auth.
Capability serializes descriptor exactly once to immutable approved Storage, hashes original bytes, returns objectRef+digest; later JSONB readbacks do not recalculate from a new encoding.
packageFormatVersions and packageFormatContracts.formatVersion must match exactly; selected input format must resolve Framework-owned verified validator/schema, not an invented Cloud package format.
cloud_private follows current canonical provider entry/readback, does not silently introduce a new SSO service or app session authority.

x-canonical-runtime-contract.binding: New image/platform fields map exactly to revision.image/platform; dependencies/inputs/mounts/health/credentials/execution preserve source semantics. Build wrappers only add publisher namespace, pinned recipe and model/data evolution extension facts.

x-example-status: All examples are synthetic executable contract fixtures, NOT published official or third-party images, standards, recipes, validators or admission evidence.
